parties: Vineet Laboratories Limited; A Srinivasa Raju
headline: Vineet Laboratories: SEBI Takeover Disclosure filed under Regulation 31(4)
sum: A Srinivasa Raju has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under the SEBI Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers Regulations, 2011 with the NSE. The filing indicates a potential substantial acquisition or change in shareholding in Vineet Laboratories Limited.
implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosures flag either a completed substantial acquisition (>25% of voting capital) or open offer trigger; counsel should obtain the full disclosure document from NSE to determine whether an open offer is mandated and the timing/structure of any required shareholder communication.
detail: A Srinivasa Raju has submitted a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 to the NSE. This regulation requires disclosure of acquisitions of shares that trigger a mandatory open offer obligation. The specific acquisition size, consideration, and conditions are not detailed in the publicly available excerpt; the full disclosure document should be accessed directly from NSE archives to establish deal parameters.
